XII. COORDINATION MEETINGS
On June 19, 1973, the Draft Environmental Impact Statement for the Airport Spur was made available to the public and was circulated to the required federal and state agencies. Section X of this Final EIS contains the letter of review and comment received from the Department of Natural Resources, Air Pollution Control Department on October 3, 1973.
On July 1, 1975 Wisconsin Administrative Code IR 154 on Indirect Source Rules became effective. To adequately respond to the new rules as well as DNR comments and satisfactorily resolve the issues, the following meetings were held.
